**Finding: Deviation (WARRANTY)**

The Agreement contains no vendor performance warranty. Section 9 ("TRUELINK WARRANTIES," p0059–p0060) is limited to a Y2K date-handling warranty for the Interface. Section 3's hosting commitments (response time, availability, bandwidth) are "reasonable commercial efforts" service descriptions, not warranties, and carry no remedy. There is no professional/workmanlike standard, no conformance-to-documentation warranty, no malicious-code or compliance-with-laws warranty, and no repair/re-performance/refund remedy — short of even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services).

One point in our favour: the disclaimer at p0076 is prefaced by "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT," so it does not swallow express warranties. No carve-out edit is needed there — the gap is simply that no express performance warranty exists to be preserved.

Redline (validated, ok:true): inserted a new warranty paragraph after p0060 at the preferred position — professional and workmanlike services, 12-month conformance for the Interface and related software, no malicious code, compliance with laws — with the standard remedy of re-performance, repair/replacement or refund of fees paid. The comment flags the 90-day/30-day fallback as available if TrueLink pushes back on duration.
